description: This is a test module for a FastAPI application that interacts with a SQL database using SQLModel. It sets up fixtures for testing CRUD operations on a 'Hero' resource, including creating, reading, listing with pagination, and deleting heroes. It also verifies the OpenAPI schema exposure.

methods.name: clear_sqlmodel()
methods.description: Clears SQLModel metadata and disposes of the default registry to reset the database state between tests.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that initializes the test database, loads the application module dynamically with different parameters, and provides a test client for API testing.

methods.name: test_crud_app(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Performs CRUD operations on the Hero API endpoints, verifying responses and data consistency, including creation, retrieval, listing with pagination, and deletion.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Fetches and verifies the OpenAPI JSON schema exposed by the FastAPI app, ensuring API documentation correctness.
